description: This file defines the ClaroPreRender class which implements various trusted prerender callback functions for the Drupal Claro theme, handling rendering modifications for elements like files, vertical tabs, containers, text formats, and messages.

classes.name: ClaroPreRender
classes.description: A class implementing trusted prerender callbacks for the Drupal Claro theme, providing static methods to modify renderable elements before they are rendered.

methods.name: managedFile
methods.description: Pre-render callback that modifies file upload elements, adding classes and wrapping single-cardinality widgets with details elements.

methods.name: verticalTabs
methods.description: Pre-render callback that adds BEM classes to vertical tabs group elements for styling as accordions.

methods.name: operations
methods.description: Pre-render callback that sets the dropbutton type for operation elements.

methods.name: container
methods.description: Pre-render callback that wraps container elements as accordions if specified.

methods.name: textFormat
methods.description: Pre-render callback that adds classes to text format elements and fixes JS inconsistencies.

methods.name: messagePlaceholder
methods.description: Pre-render callback that inserts a fallback message placeholder for status messages.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns a list of callback method names that are trusted for rendering.
